description_en: Queries the information about a specified network access endpoint
description_zh: 查询指定的网络端点信息
kebab_example: aliyun eiam get-network-access-endpoint --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --network-access-endpoint-id nae-examplexxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNetworkAccessEndpoint
